paper_model.name: MABPT-ASCENT
paper_model.identity: one finite-measure multimodal aircraft trajectory prediction model

evidence_boundary.internal_confirmatory: not locally available; the C127 locked test was opened on 2026-08-05 and is historical evidence only
evidence_boundary.external_confirmatory: not locally available; requires a never-opened airport or time period
evidence_boundary.test_opening_rule: open a newly acquired confirmatory cohort once only after every seed, baseline, ablation and smoke gate is complete

training.checkpoint: fixed epoch 20 for ASCENT branches and fixed epoch 10 for the registered TrajAirNet baseline

data.historical_opened_test_policy: do not use as fresh MABPT-ASCENT confirmation
data.independent_unit: calendar date, with flights or scenes nested within date

primary_hypotheses.H1: MABPT-ASCENT improves Energy Score over matched original ASCENT.
primary_hypotheses.H2: MABPT-ASCENT improves top-1 FDE and does not degrade minFDE at the prespecified operational margin.
primary_hypotheses.H3: MABPT-ASCENT improves fixed-event Brier score and does not degrade fixed-event NLL.
primary_hypotheses.H4: MABPT-ASCENT improves conflict Brier score and does not degrade recall at a development-fixed FPR.

analysis.bootstrap: paired hierarchical airport then date then flight or scene
analysis.report: absolute effect, relative effect, confidence interval, raw p value and adjusted p value
analysis.noninferiority_margins: must be justified before test opening from aviation-operational tolerances; no post-result margin selection

stopping_rule: Report every fixed seed and registered arm. Failed or interrupted runs remain visible. Do not tune after opening a newly acquired confirmatory cohort.
